supply_hero_title: Premium Stone Supply for Villas, Facades & Landmark Developments
supply_hero_desc: From hand-carved architectural elements to precision-cut cladding panels, Prime Rock supplies natural and artificial stone products engineered for durability, detail, and design impact across the UAE and Pakistan.
supply_arch_desc: Hand-detailed finials, capitals, and ornamental pieces for columns, gates, and entrances.
supply_cladding_desc: Weather-resistant façade panels in split-face, geometric, and diamond-cut finishes.
supply_why_title: Why Contractors Choose Prime Rock Supply
supply_feature_1_desc: Every piece can be produced to match your architect's exact specifications and drawings.
supply_feature_2_desc: Products engineered to hold color, texture, and structural integrity under UAE heat and humidity.
supply_feature_3_desc: Clear production schedules and delivery coordination for both single-piece and bulk orders.
supply_final_cta_title: Ready to Source Your Project's Stonework?
supply_final_cta_desc: Send us your drawings or reference images — we'll confirm material, pricing, and lead time within 24 hours.
install_hero_title: Precision Stone Installation for Villas, Facades & Commercial Spaces
install_hero_desc: From cladding to intricate architectural detailing, Prime Rock's installation teams deliver clean lines, secure bonding, and a finish built to last — backed by real on-site expertise, not guesswork.
install_intro_title: Installation Quality Is What Separates a Good Façade From a Great One
install_intro_p1: Even the finest stone can look uneven, crack prematurely, or weather poorly if installation is rushed or handled by inexperienced labor. That's why Prime Rock treats installation as a specialized craft — not an afterthought to supply.
install_intro_p2: Our installation teams work directly from architectural drawings, use climate-appropriate bonding methods, and inspect every panel before it's signed off — so what you see on day one still looks sharp years later.
install_process_subtitle: A structured, four-step process built for accuracy and accountability.
install_step_1_desc: Our team visits your site to evaluate surface conditions, structural requirements, and finalize measurements before any material is cut.
install_step_2_desc: Stone panels and elements are pre-cut, numbered, and sequenced according to your architectural drawings for precise on-site fitting.
install_step_3_desc: Experienced installers apply industry-standard bonding, anchoring, and jointing techniques suited to UAE climate conditions.
install_step_4_desc: Every completed section is inspected for alignment, finish, and structural integrity before final handover.
install_trust_title: Why Clients Trust Our Installation Teams
install_guarantee_1_desc: Our installation crews are trained specifically in natural and artificial stone application — not general contracting labor.
install_guarantee_2_desc: Bonding and sealing methods engineered to withstand UAE heat, humidity, and seasonal temperature swings.
install_guarantee_3_desc: Clear project timelines agreed upfront, with progress updates so you always know installation status.
install_faq_title: Common Questions About Our Installation Services
install_faq_1_q: How long does a typical villa façade installation take?
install_faq_1_a: Most villa façade installations take between 1–3 weeks depending on square footage, stone type, and site access — we confirm an exact timeline after site assessment.
install_faq_2_q: Do you handle both supply and installation together?
install_faq_2_a: Yes — Prime Rock supplies the stone and installs it, so there's a single point of accountability for material quality and workmanship.
install_faq_3_q: Can you install stone we've sourced elsewhere?
install_faq_3_a: In most cases, yes. Share your material specs with us and we'll confirm compatibility with our installation methods.
install_final_cta_title: Get a Free On-Site Installation Assessment
install_final_cta_desc: Share your project details and our team will schedule a site visit to confirm scope, timeline, and cost — no obligation.
consult_hero_title: Expert Guidance on Material, Finish & Technical Specification
consult_hero_desc: Choosing the right stone isn't just about looks — it's about performance, budget, and buildability. Prime Rock's consultancy service helps architects, contractors, and homeowners make confident, technically sound decisions before a single stone is cut.
consult_intro_title: Get It Right Before You Order, Not After
consult_intro_p1: The costliest mistakes in stonework happen at the decision stage — the wrong finish for a high-traffic façade, a material that can't hit the project timeline, or a spec that doesn't match the architectural drawings. Prime Rock's consultancy service exists to catch these issues early.
consult_intro_p2: Whether you're an architect finalizing a material palette, a contractor validating quantities against a budget, or a homeowner deciding between natural and artificial stone for a villa façade, our team brings real supply and installation experience to every recommendation — not just a product catalog.
consult_process_subtitle: A clear, four-step process from first conversation to final specification.
consult_step_1_desc: We understand your project scope, style direction, and budget before recommending any materials.
consult_step_2_desc: Guided selection from our natural and artificial stone range, matched to your project's climate, usage, and design intent.
consult_step_3_desc: Our team reviews architectural drawings to confirm dimensions, quantities, and technical feasibility before production begins.
consult_step_4_desc: You receive a clear specification sheet — materials, finishes, estimated quantities, and budget — ready for approval or tender.
consult_trust_title: Why Clients Rely on Our Recommendations
consult_guarantee_1_desc: Recommendations grounded in real manufacturing and installation constraints, not just aesthetics.
consult_guarantee_2_desc: We help you balance design ambition with cost — flagging trade-offs early, not after material is ordered.
consult_guarantee_3_desc: Clear documentation and specs that plug directly into your existing project workflow and drawings.
consult_faq_title: Common Questions About Our Consultancy Service
consult_faq_1_q: Do I need to have finalized architectural drawings before consulting you?
consult_faq_1_a: No — we can advise at concept stage and refine recommendations as your drawings develop. Having drawings simply speeds up the process.
consult_faq_2_q: Is the consultation free if I proceed with supply or installation?
consult_faq_2_a: Yes, initial consultation is complimentary when it leads to a Prime Rock supply or installation project. Standalone technical consultancy is quoted separately.
consult_faq_3_q: Can you help choose between natural stone and artificial stone for my project?
consult_faq_3_a: Yes — this is one of the most common consultations we handle, weighing cost, maintenance, durability, and appearance for your specific application.
consult_final_cta_title: Talk to Our Team Before You Finalize Your Material Order
consult_final_cta_desc: Share your project drawings or ideas — we'll help you land on the right material, finish, and spec with confidence.
